name: In Need of Relief
summary: A guard at Bolder'ok needs relief after the lion hides are gathered and orcish poachers are culled. Dunston Willis has not returned from the ogre settlement, and you are asked to find him.

sections.title: A Missing Relief
sections.body: At Bolder'ok, the watch remains without its promised relief. Dunston Willis, an explorer, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago and was expected back to take over the post. The guard asks you to find him among the ogres. If Dunston is alive, bring him back; if not, bring proof so Demar can send someone else.

faq.answer: Dunston Willis is an explorer who went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north of Bolder'ok.

faq.q: Why is the guard looking for Dunston?
faq.answer: Dunston was expected to return and take over the guard's post, but he has not come back.
Dunston went to investigate the ogre settlement at Bolder'ok.

faq.q: What does the guard ask me to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to find Dunston among the ogres. If he is alive, bring him back; otherwise, bring proof so Demar can send another guard.

faq.q: What happened before Dunston went missing?
faq.answer: The lion hides were collected and the orcish poachers were culled before the guard expected Dunston to relieve the watch.
